explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1087. A 4-point set is degenerate when two of its six pairwise distances coincide, encoded as having fewer than C(4,2) = 6 distinct distances. f(n) is the maximum number of degenerate 4-subsets over n-point planar sets. f(n) ≤ n^{3+o(1)} is encoded as f(n) = O(n^{3+ε}) for every ε > 0, which is equivalent. The open question is stated in the affirmative.
